resources.string: Clickme reads your device notifications locally. No data leaves your phone.

Clickme is a lightweight, on-device notification reader for Android. It captures notifications through the system Notification Listener service and presents them in a single, searchable timeline. The application runs entirely on the device and is designed to stay responsive even under a high volume of incoming notifications.

All notification data is processed and stored locally in memory. No content is transmitted over the network, uploaded to a server, or shared with third parties. Clickme requires notification access solely to display your notifications on this device, and you can revoke that access at any time from system settings.
Built with Kotlin and AndroidX, using Material 3 for the interface and a NotificationListenerService for capture. Releases are produced through an automated, reproducible GitHub Actions pipeline.
